name: turn-cap-builder
summary: A builder agent with a tool-call cap: nudge at 90, hard stop at 115, handoff file instead of a resume.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (reports allowed past the cap live in $HUBKIT_HOME/reports)
env.TURN_CAP_NUDGE: tool calls before the nudge, default 90
env.TURN_CAP_BLOCK: tool calls before the hard stop, default 115
env.TURN_CAP_EXEMPT: comma list of agent types never capped, default bug-gate,playtester,planner
env.TURN_CAP_REPORTS_DIR: folder that Write/Edit may still touch past the cap, default $HUBKIT_HOME/reports

notes: The hooks are declared in builder.md's own frontmatter, so nothing is added to settings.json.
